jobDescription:
Primary Responsibility:
A React developer's primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain dynamic, responsive, and user-friendly web interfaces using React.js. They create reusable components, manage application state with tools like Redux or Context API, and integrate frontend systems with APIs to ensure seamless data flow...

Job Specification
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3. - Expertise in React.js and its core principles (components, JSX, hooks, context API). - Familiarity with state management libraries like Redux, MobX, or Zustand. - Experience with RESTful APIs or GraphQL integration. - Knowledge of frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite, Babel) and package managers (npm/yarn). - Understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development. - Experience with CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS, Material-UI, or Bootstrap. - Proficiency in optimizing React applications using lazy loading, code splitting, and minimizing re-renders. - Experience with testing frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress. - Experience in Agile or Scrum development methodologies. - Proficiency in using Git for version control and participating in CI/CD pipelines for deployment.

Angular 21+ — hands-on experience with standalone components, signals, modern Angular patterns, dependency injection, lifecycle hooks, and a good understanding of Angular change detection and performance optimization.

● JavaScript / TypeScript — strong fundamentals in JavaScript and TypeScript; comfortable with types, interfaces, generics, classes, OOP concepts, async/await, promises, closures, and the JavaScript event loop (call stack, microtasks, task queue, etc.).

● RxJS & Reactive Programming — good understanding of Observables, Subjects, operators such as map, switchMap, mergeMap, catchError, tap, debounceTime, distinctUntilChanged, takeUntil, etc.; understands subscriptions, unsubscription, memory leaks, and handling asynchronous streams.

● Real-time Communication – WebSockets / SSE — practical experience working with WebSockets and/or Server-Sent Events. Should understand streaming data, connection lifecycle, reconnection/error handling, subscriptions, and updating the UI efficiently as real-time data arrives.

● HTML5 & CSS/SCSS — strong understanding of semantic HTML, responsive layouts, CSS fundamentals, Flexbox/Grid, and SCSS. Should be comfortable building and styling UI without depending entirely on CSS frameworks.

● Forms in Angular — hands-on experience with both Reactive Forms and Template-driven Forms, including form validation, custom validators, dynamic forms, nested/form groups, form arrays, error handling, and managing form state.

● API Integration — experience consuming REST/HTTP APIs using Angular's HttpClient, handling loading/success/error states, request cancellation, retries where appropriate, interceptors, and asynchronous API responses.

● State Management — understanding of state management beyond component-local variables. Experience with Angular Signals, shared services, RxJS-based state, or state management libraries.

● Data Visualization – Charts & Graphs — experience working with charts/graphs and transforming API data into visualization-ready formats. Experience with ngx-charts or similar charting libraries is highly preferred.

● Authentication & Authorization — understanding of token-based authentication and OAuth/OIDC concepts, including access tokens, refresh tokens, token expiration, login/logout flows, route guards, and HTTP interceptors.

● Angular Material / Component Libraries — practical experience with Angular Material or similar UI component libraries, including dialogs, tables, forms, menus, tooltips, buttons, pagination, and theming/customization.

● Git — comfortable with branching, pull requests, merging/rebasing, resolving conflicts, reviewing changes, and maintaining a clean and meaningful commit history.

● Unit Testing — understanding of what should be tested and why. Experience with Jest, Jasmine, Karma, Vitest, or similar frameworks; able to write tests for components, services, utilities, and important business logic.

● Debugging & Problem Solving — strong debugging skills using browser DevTools, network inspection, console/debugger, Angular DevTools, reading stack traces, identifying root causes, and isolating frontend vs. backend issues.

● Code Quality & Clean Code — follows readable, maintainable, reusable code practices. Understands DRY, basic SOLID principles, separation of concerns, appropriate component/service design, performance optimization, and working within linting/formatting standards.

● Angular Performance — awareness of unnecessary change detection, efficient rendering of lists and large datasets, avoiding memory leaks, lazy loading, appropriate use of signals/RxJS, and optimizing components that handle frequently changing or streaming data.

● Team Collaboration — comfortable participating in code reviews, addressing review feedback, communicating blockers, discussing technical trade-offs, and pairing with other developers when needed.

● Learning & Ownership — demonstrates the ability to learn new technologies and patterns, investigate unfamiliar problems independently, close knowledge gaps, and take ownership of tasks through completion.

‍

Good-to-have
● Accessibility (a11y) — understanding of semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA, focus management, and basic accessibility practices.

● E2E Testing — exposure to Playwright, Cypress, or similar end-to-end testing frameworks.

● CI/CD — basic understanding of frontend build and deployment pipelines, environments, build configurations, and automated checks.

● AI / LLM Product UI — experience building AI-powered interfaces such as chat applications, streaming responses, typing indicators, conversation history, markdown rendering, file uploads, or token-by-token response streaming.

● Advanced Data Visualization — experience with interactive charts, dashboards, large datasets, real-time chart updates, custom chart configurations, or libraries such as ngx-charts, D3.js, Chart.js, ECharts, etc.

● Canvas / SVG — exposure to SVG, Canvas, or visualization libraries for building interactive diagrams, graphs, flow editors, or node-based interfaces.

● Cloud / AWS — basic familiarity with AWS services commonly used by frontend applications, such as Cognito, S3, CloudWatch, or API Gateway.

● Web Performance — familiarity with browser rendering, network optimization, bundle size optimization, lazy loading, caching, and performance profiling.

● Responsive & Cross-browser Development — experience ensuring applications work consistently across different browsers, screen sizes, and devices.

● NgRx — basic understanding of NgRx and its core architecture, including the unidirectional data flow pattern; familiarity with when and why to use NgRx for predictable state managementin larger Angular applications.

‍

Application Process
You can apply on this job portal, or submit your resume and relevant details to: placement@emplay.net

Email subject line: Application – Frontend Developer – Emplay Inc

Please include the following in your email:

●  Current CTC

●  Expected CTC

●  Notice period

●  Years of relevant experience

●  Reason for job change

●  LinkedIn profile link

jobDescription:
Simbian® is building Agentic AI platform for cybersecurity. Founded by repeat successful security founders, we have gathered an excellent cohort of employees, partners, and customers. 

Our mission is to solve security using AI and our core values are excellence, replication, and intellectual honesty. 
Our promise is to make Simbian the best workplace of your career and we believe a small group of thoughtful passionate people can make all the positive difference in the world. 

To fuel our fast growth, we are seeking an exceptional candidate who shares our core values of excellence (being the world's best at our craft), replication (share your best ideas with others), and intellectual honesty (tell the truth even if it's bitter). 

Our AI Agents automate security operations and provide our customers 10x leverage. Our customers include some of the world's largest companies. Our initial use cases include:  
SOC alert triage and investigation 
Prioritization and classification of vulnerabilities 
AI based threat hunting

Job Description
The Role

 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to help shape the face of Simbian's product. You will work closely with design, product, and backend engineers to build the interfaces through which security teams interact with our AI agents. The work is technically demanding and visually consequential: you will be building dashboards, real-time alert workflows, and investigation UIs that security analysts rely on under pressure.



What You Will Do
Own and evolve core product surfaces: dashboards, alert queues, investigation flows, and agent activity timelines
Build responsive, accessible, high-performance UIs using ReactJS, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN component primitives
Architect reusable component libraries and design systems that scale with the product
Collaborate with backend engineers to define clean API contracts and integrate real-time data (WebSocket's, polling, streaming)
Lead frontend technical decisions, from state management patterns to performance optimization strategies
Participate in design reviews and push back when something is not implementable cleanly
 



Requirements
What We Are Looking For

1 to 3 years of professional frontend engineering experience 
Deep expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript; you write type safe code by default 
Strong command of ReactJS, including hooks, context, and component design patterns 
Handson experience with Tailwind CSS and component libraries (ShadCN or similar) 
Solid understanding of HTML semantics and CSS layout (flexbox, grid, responsive design) 
Ability to translate complex workflows and data heavy UIs into clean, intuitive interfaces 
Experience working in fastmoving, product focused environments where you ship often and iterate quickly Strong communication skills and comfort working cross functionally 
 

Nice to Have 

Experience building security tooling, SOC platforms, or enterprise SaaS dashboards 
Familiarity with real-time data rendering (WebSockets, server sent events) 
Exposure to data visualization libraries (Recharts, D3, or similar) 
Experience setting up or contributing to a design system from scratch 
Prior work at an early-stage startup and excellent pedigree 


Benefits
Why Simbian? 

You will work on a product that is actively used by security teams defending real organizations from real threats 
Small team, large surface area: your decisions shape the product, not just your ticket queue 
Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
We move fast, we trust engineers, and we debate things openly
